item_name: Rothco Police Small Pepper Spray Holder with Flap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Police Small Pepper Spray Holder with Flap is designed for mounting on your duty belt to provide rapid access to your pepper spray cannister.
description: Rothco’s Police Small Pepper Spray Holder with Flap is designed for mounting on your duty belt to provide rapid access to your pepper spray cannister. This pepper spray holder fits perfectly onto Rothco’s Police Duty Belt (10570), making it the perfect accessory. Constructed of durable poly webbing, the duty belt pouch accommodates spray cannisters up to 5 inches tall X 2 inches wide.
